decision: Ve set this on 2026-11-23 in an interactive session, answering two direct questions: 'How much should the loops auto-approve without asking you?' -> 'Everything but server/data' (auto-approve every proposal and spec after a veto window, except ones that change the server, stored data or protected areas), and 'Which loops?' -> CardLens and Ops hub (not portfolio).
howItWorks: The runner posts one notice on each eligible issue ('Auto-approves via Ve's policy at <time> unless you comment /hold'); after vetoHours it is built without an approved label. A /hold comment, closing the issue, or editing its body after the notice stops it for good; adding approved builds it at once. Eligibility: innovation/gate-rules.ps1 Get-ViaPolicyDecision (fails closed).
offSwitch: Set enabled to false (commit and push from D:\projects\cardlens): manual approval again at the next check, nothing else changes. The loop's sessions can never write this file.
